title: Half-open window count includes the endpoint
root_cause: The window-counting function was changed to add one to the difference between its endpoints. That counts the excluded endpoint of a half-open interval, so the existing test receives five slots instead of four. The runner image version also changed, but the arithmetic change directly explains the assertion.

relevant_evidence.why: The empty-window test passes while the half-open-window test fails.
The assertion expects four slots but receives five.
The function adds one to the endpoint difference despite its half-open contract.
